item.title: 'Palestinians are unbelievable people: Vast majority of in Gaza just want to live a normal life'
item.description: Angela Diffley is pleased to welcome Dr. Adi Nadimpalli, Medical Coordinator for Gaza with Doctors Without Borders. He offers a stark assessment of conditions in Gaza following the October 2025 ceasefire. item.title: Middle East live: US downs two Iranian drones targeting Hormuz shipping traffic
item.description: The US military said late Saturday it downed two Iranian attack drones threatening Strait of Hormuz shipping traffic in the latest clash between the warring forces in the Middle East. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.

item.title: What to know about a rare visit by China's Xi to North Korea for talks with Kim Jong Un
item.description: Chinese leader Xi Jinping is traveling to North Korea for the first time in nearly seven years, offering North Korean leader Kim Jong Un a stage to showcase an increasingly assertive foreign policy anchored by closer ties with his country’s former Cold...

item.title: 'Not your country': Lebanese leaders rebuke Iran as Israel, Hezbollah trade attacks
item.description: Lebanon's president and prime minister criticised Iran on Friday for opposing the latest ceasefire deal between the Lebanese government and Israel, saying their country should not be used by Tehran as a "bargaining chip" in talks with Washington. Despite the truce, Lebanese media reported continued Israeli attacks on the south while Iran-backed Hezbollah said it targeted Israeli troops with drones and rockets.

item.title: Hezbollah chief rejects truce as Israel vows continued operations in south Lebanon
item.description: Hezbollah on Thursday rejected the latest ceasefire agreement between Israel and the Lebanese government, demanding a complete Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon as more fighting there hampered efforts to end the Iran war. The Hezbollah announcement came as Israeli strikes killed at least eight people, according to Lebanese authorities, and a UN peacekeeper was killed in the crossfire.

item.title: Iran launched missiles and drones toward Strait of Hormuz, U.S. military says
item.description: U.S. forces shot down Iranian missiles and drones launched toward the strait and neighboring countries.

item.title: A 'ceasefire war' in Lebanon continues as 'chaotic global leadership' takes its toll
item.description: Hezbollah's chief on Thursday rejected a conditional truce announced by Lebanese and Israeli envoys, demanding instead a comprehensive ceasefire and full Israeli withdrawal as he threatened northern Israel with new attacks. FRANCE 24's Noga Tarnopolsky reports from Jerusalem.

item.title: Ukraine: Dear Putin, Lebanon: A Crude Call, Colombia's 'Tiger'
item.description: In a week where a renewed ceasefire was proclaimed between Israel and Lebanon, a deal that hinges on the complete cessation of attacks from the Iranian backed militants Hezbollah and withdrawal from the south of the country.

item.title: Iran says no 'tangible progress' in war talks, Trump says deal close
item.description: Iran's foreign minister said on Wednesday that negotiations to end the Middle East war had made "no tangible progress" after fresh US and Iranian strikes tested a fragile ceasefire. Kuwaiti officials said an Iranian drone strike on Kuwait International Airport killed one person and wounded 63, while President Donald Trump said talks could produce a breakthrough "over the weekend."

item.title: What to Know About the Ebola Outbreak
item.description: Aid agencies are racing to help health workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The virus is known to have killed at least 84, but the true toll may be far higher.
